integrity: Full symbolic proof and reproducible finite literal-factor checker are included. Computation is not substituted for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Optimization is over binary cyclic words with exactly three occurrences of 1; it does not establish unrestricted circular-word optimality.
Maximizer classification is up to rotation and reversal, not oriented-necklace multiplicity.
Historical priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed results.
title: Exact palindromic complexity and extremizers of three-marker circular words
